# Draft:Culture Circle

----
Culture Circle
[https://culture-circle.com Culture Circle] is an Indian e-commerce marketplace specialising in “hype” and luxury products including authenticated sneakers, streetwear, designer apparel, handbags, and other accessories.It was founded by Devansh Jain Nawal and Ackshay Jain. The platform aggregates thousands of sellers and offers millions of listings, aiming to address demand for rare and authenticated luxury items in India.
Culture circe was also mentioned in the [https://www.forbes.com Forbes] magazine and the founders were mentioned in Forbes 30 under 30
The company claims to provide product authentication and verification through a proprietary system including a seller-verification and KYC process plus authentication certificates via a partner (often referred to as “CheckCheck”).
Culture Circle operates via a consumer-facing app and an internal platform for sellers called [https://www.sourcex.app SourceX], intended to help sellers manage listings, operations, and profit-and-loss (PnL).
History
* 2023  Founding: [https://culture-circle.com/ Culture Circle] was founded by Devansh Jain Nawal and Ackshay Jain, motivated by a lack of reliable platforms for rare sneakers and luxury streetwear in India.
* 2023 Initial phase as aggregator: The company started as a search aggregator/marketplace for fashion, footwear, and luxury items.
* Early 2024 Launch of consumer app: According to their official narrative, the “official consumer app” was launched in January 2024 to serve retail customers directly.
* 2024 — Seed funding: In December 2024, Culture Circle reportedly raised a seed round (cited as $2 million) led by Info Edge Ventures.
* 2025 — Strategic investment from Ritesh Agarwal : In mid-2025, Culture Circle secured further investment from Ritesh Agarwal, reportedly valuing the company at over ₹100 crore.
* 2025 — Public attention via Shark Tank India: The company gained wider visibility after appearing on Shark Tank India, where founders discussed their business, declined a large offer (₹8 crore), and instead accepted a strategic deal for ₹3 crore in exchange for 3% equity.
Stores
Culture circle have their stores in the respective locations
Delhi: Ambience Mall, Vasant Kunj
The store opened on 14 September 2024.
Hyderabad: Banjara Hills, Road 2
The store opened on 9 March 2025
